title: The Harbor of Sandpiper Point
author: Astrid Lockridge
blurb: Edmund Whitlock, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
